items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: I thought they called him . Lipposian.

ctx.x: I was freaking drunk, half drunk and spent all the money on the way. I knew he got nothing. I said, I don't want the arms. I got a good test. That's why I was like, I stepped on the table and pushed face. He was trying like he was on the table. He took a big dish, a big pan, a big old lousey and he killed that boy. I mean, bang! I was drunk again. He couldn't work. He got up and he was running outside. I said, oh, you're not hearing like that. I said, oh, you're not hearing like that.

Yeah, down the coast. He came from down the Beauderous down there. That's why he come. Yeah. We met her. She said, I said, how did that call? She told us her name. She was asking me. I sat down in the neighborhood and asked me if I know so and so. I said, I might know. She said, you got a bottom in town and two places. I said, yeah. I said, what's his name? She told me. And I was saying I didn't know. She told me the name. I thought they called him . Lipposian.
